title: Machine page: the machine summary is one run-on line; show it as a two-column property grid that wraps

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

body:
Reported by the maintainer (screenshot of "Machine - Setup1" in chat): the machine overview is unreadable.

## What happens
Under "Machine", the page prints `MachineDef::summary()` (`crates/post/src/machine/def.rs:351`) as one sentence, e.g.

> milling machine - Camcraft Makera Carvera - spindle ?-15000 rpm, 3 axes (3 with a known stroke), 0.2 kW, 6-slot changer, coolant Air

followed by "milling workspace" and "loaded from built-in: Makera Carvera". The result:
- It's a run-on line wrapping at random points, so you can't scan it for one value.
- `spindle ?-15000 rpm` shows the unknown minimum as a bare `?`.
- `3 axes (3 with a known stroke)` is jargon; the strokes themselves aren't shown.

## Wanted
A **two-column property grid** (label | value), word-wrapping values to the panel width, with labels aligned in one column:

| | |
|---|---|
| Kind | Milling |
| Machine | Makera Carvera (Camcraft) |
| Spindle | up to 15000 rpm (min not stated) · 0.2 kW |
| Axes | X 0 … 300 · Y 0 … 200 · Z -100 … 0 mm (each stroke, or "stroke not stated") |
| Tool changer | 6 slots |
| Coolant | Air |
| Workspace | Milling |
| Source | Built-in: Makera Carvera |

- Units follow the document (mm/in).
- Missing values say "not stated", never `?`.
- Keep `summary()` for the one-line uses (setup sheet, `boundary_draft`), or add a structured accessor (rows of label/value) that both the page and the sheet use, so the two can't drift.
- The machine editor's header (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_editor.rs:74`) uses the same line; give it the same grid.

## Done means
- The Machine page shows the grid. Structural test: the labels Kind, Machine, Spindle, Axes, Tool changer, Coolant and Source are present as separate rows, and no `?` appears for a machine with no minimum spindle speed.
- Values wrap within the pane at narrow widths (no horizontal overflow), checked structurally where possible, hand-tested otherwise; no snapshot PNG changes.
- `crates/app/tests/machine.rs` (which asserts the old summary text) is updated to the structured rows, or keeps passing if `summary()` stays for one-line uses.
